overview: Deterministic E2E validation for demo operator loop: persistent toolbar, allowlisted pack load/reload, checklist progression, elapsed timing, and history reopen behavior.
goals: Keep checklist state and elapsed timing explicit.
successMetrics: Demo pack load/reload consistently opens fresh matter context.
Checklist state progression is visible and coherent.
History reopen shortcuts preserve expected context.
uiNotes: Checklist exposes `todo/in_progress/done` and minute-level elapsed only.

importFormat.description: Scenario uses allowlisted packs and demo load endpoint.

rules: Only allowlisted packs can be loaded.

stories.title: Load and Replay Demo Packs Reliably
stories.description: As a demo operator, I need repeatable pack loading with checklist visibility and quick reopen actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Given demo mode is enabled, toolbar shows `DEMO MODE` and allowlisted pack options.
When loading a pack, system creates/opens a demo matter and checklist context appears.
Then checklist states and elapsed minutes are visible and update deterministically.
Example: `Load pack again` produces a fresh demo matter while previous history remains reopenable.
Negative: non-allowlisted pack submission returns validation error and opens no matter.
